newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israelis suspect suicide bombers behind attacks.
newsitem.headline: Israelis suspect suicide bombers behind attacks.

text.p: Israeli police said they believed two suicide bombers carried out an attack that killed at least 18 people on Wednesday in an outdoor market in Jewish west Jerusalem.
"The assumption is that there were two suicide bombers carrying bags in two parallel roads in the market," police spokeswoman Linda Menuhin said in a statement.
Israeli Police Chief Assaf Hefetz told reporters a closure had been imposed on the West Bank and Gaza Strip barring the entry of Palestinians to Israel.

The attack on the Mahane Yehuda market was the deadliest against Israelis since the election of Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu 14 months ago on a promise to better protect Israelis' security from suicide bombing attacks.
